The '''Caves of Corips''' was a location in the [[Corips system/Legends|Corips system]].

==History==
The caves consisted of rocks and soil. [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] likened walking inside the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] interior as walking inside the caves, but with illuminated tubing and [[Plasteel/Legends|plastisteel]] replacing the natural surroundings.
